name.zh: Pluricarpellatia 早期水生被子植物

description.en: Rooted rhizomes support long-stalked small peltate leaves and reproductive stalks.
description.zh: 生根根茎支撑长柄小盾叶及生殖柄。

scientific_scope.en: Conservative whole-organism reconstruction concept for Pluricarpellatia peltata; cited fossils support gross structures, while unpreserved proportions and colour remain artistic choices.
scientific_scope.zh: Pluricarpellatia peltata 的保守整株重建概念；所引化石支持主要结构，未保存比例和颜色仍属美术选择。

distinctness.en: A connected rooted rhizome with separate long leaf and reproductive stalks differs from free-floating rosettes and the isolated Nelumbo leaf.
distinctness.zh: 相连生根根茎及分立长叶柄、生殖柄区别于自由浮生莲座和单片古莲叶。

modeling_brief.en: Expose the horizontal rhizome and stalk origins; use modest heart-to-peltate blades, without a large modern lily flower.
modeling_brief.zh: 显露水平根茎和柄基，使用适度心形至盾形叶，不加入大型现代睡莲花。

uncertainty: Phyllotaxis and exact family placement remain uncertain; near-complete fossils support the general habit.
reference_notes: Planning record only. Source access labels distinguish opened pages from indexed abstracts/excerpts. Reference-ready is not a released model or a completed dimensional/rights audit.

sources.title: Pluricarpellatia, a nymphaealean angiosperm from the Lower Cretaceous of northern Gondwana
sources.supports: Near-complete rooted aquatic plants with peltate leaves and reproductive structures.
